description: Reflections on events and relationships in Maria Chabot's life in the light of and with long quotations from Krishnamurti with two to three copies of each chapter [The last file in this folder, 1975-80 Celestina's Garden, is a reflection specifically on why MC stopped writing the book on Mexico, 1975 - 1980 (see, MCA - MC Research and notes, Literary - Mexico), and on how and why she wrote this autobiographical account.]
title: Autobiography
